items.description: Footage released by the French Armed Forces shows French Navy personnel intercepting a vessel 'suspected of sailing under a false flag' south of La Réunion, a French overseas department in the Indian Ocean.

items.title: Palestinians dream of returning home after Israel raids West Bank camps
items.description: Palestinians have been displaced from their homes in Tulkarem refugee camp and dream of returning home.

items.title: Russia Pounds Ukraine In Overnight Missile And Drone Attacks
items.description: Russia launched overnight missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, striking Kyiv, Kharkiv, and other regions. At least four people were killed in Kharkiv. The attacks came amid a US-proposed energy cease-fire that Moscow has not confirmed.

items.title: How NATO plans to combat potential attacks on the alliance from Russia
items.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with former U.S. Assistant Secretary for European Affairs Dan Hamilton about NATO's detailed plans to counter any possible Russian attack on the alliance.

items.title: Houthis, Saudis exchange strikes on airports as Mideast conflict intensifies
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen accuse Saudi Arabia of striking the rebel-held airport in Sanaa. This accusation comes amid escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

items.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
items.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.
